implementation_notes: Added `[nats]` (`nats-py>=2.0,<3`) and `[graphiti]` (`graphiti-core>=0.9,<1`) optional-extras groups to pyproject.toml's `[project.optional-dependencies]` block. Pin rationale: nats-py lower bound `>=2.0` mirrors the sibling `nats-core/pyproject.toml` runtime convention (`nats-py>=2.0`); upper bound `<3` caps at the next major to match the Phase 1 langchain-* `<2` convention. graphiti-core lower bound `>=0.9` is the first 0.9.x line shipping the pydantic-2 / FalkorDB combo Jarvis relies on (`.guardkit/graphiti.yaml` configures `graph_store: falkordb`); upper bound `<1` caps before the expected breaking 1.0 surface change. `uv sync --extra providers` resolved cleanly: nats-py==2.14.0 and graphiti-core==0.29.0 installed alongside their transitives (neo4j, posthog, openai, etc). Updated the Phase 2 `TestAC002NatsPyNotDeclared.test_nats_py_not_in_optional_dependencies` assertion: it was a temporal Phase 2 invariant ('nats-py forbidden in optional-extras until FEAT-JARVIS-004' — see the original docstring), and Phase 4 is the moment it lifts. Renamed it to `test_nats_py_only_in_phase4_optional_groups` and tightened it to allow nats-py in `[nats]` and `[providers]` only, forbidding any other group. The other Phase 2 invariants (no nats-py in runtime, dev-group, or [tool.uv.sources]) still hold and remain enforced. New `tests/test_phase4_dependencies.py` mirrors the Phase 2 helper layout class-per-AC for review parity.
